The '''Yarith sector''', named after Lady [[Yarith Figg]], was a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] area of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It bordered the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]], and shared a jagged border with the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] designed specifically to check ambitions in both sectors. Anoat sector and Yarith sector were jointly called the Twin Nebulae sectors. Yarith sector was the location of the [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax Nebula]].

The sector capital was [[Isde Naha/Legends|Isde Naha]], located on the extreme lower edge of the sector.
